subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: What bounded outbound evidence should Plugin SDK hooks be allowed to receive before delivery for deterministic verification?
rationale: The remaining work is not just plumbing: it decides whether plugins may see recent transcript/tool-call/tool-result data, how that data is redacted and bounded, and whether message_sending or reply_payload_sending is the public contract.

options.title: Design bounded evidence contract
options.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields and permission requirements before implementation.

options.title: Make reply_payload_sending canonical
options.body: Declare the current payload hook as the supported pre-delivery surface and narrow this issue to missing evidence fields on that hook.

options.title: Fold into broader trace work
options.body: Make the broader trace/outbound policy issue canonical after preserving this issue's deterministic verification examples.

recommendation.title: Design bounded evidence contract
recommendation.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields and permission requirements before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current routing signal from the prior issue review and adjacent outbound hook follow-up work.
